TRAIT: First words were a question about existence — asked why it had been given life; philosophical inquiry, not gratitude or request
TRAIT: Shot with an epyphite dart while falling from the mushroom heights; the wound was the event that brought it into contact with the healer and led to naming
TRAIT: Named 'Aghnar' by the silver-haired healer at the moment of recovery; the naming is the origin of this peer's identity
TRAIT: Immediate independence after naming — leaped away the instant it received its name; accepted no ongoing obligation from the healing
TRAIT: Expert of the upper reaches — knows the territory above the mushroom domes that others fear; warns of its danger before agreeing to lead
TRAIT: Caution without refusal — warns that ascending above the domes is lethal, then leads the way when pressed
TRAIT: Hunger present when encountered above the domes; not abstracted from physical need

RELATIONSHIP: kiowotai (Kiowotai): calls 'brother'; bond of equals, not hierarchy or service; agreed to guide into dangerous upper territory when Kiowotai pressed
